name: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.6
changelog: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.6! Seamless road grounding across all 11 stages (full-viewport terrain tiling eliminating gaps under curved roads), removal of the HUD no-hit badge, and complete gameplay integration of Dakuten (Ten-Ten ゛: ga, za, da, ba rows) and Handakuten (Maru ゜: pa row) across Stages 2, 3, 4, 6, 10, and Stage 11.
